subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive (ML / Infra)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive (ML / Infra)

Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier today. Thanks for walking through your current ingestion pipeline and the key latency/cost goals you shared. As discussed, the best next step is a 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML and infra teams so we can:

- Walk through your model/hosting constraints (sequence lengths, batch sizes, peak QPS)
- Review data privacy/networking requirements (VPC, egress controls)
- Discuss candidate model families, quantization options, and expected token-cost profile
- Align on rollout plan and SLOs for the initial integration

Proposed times (all PT):
- Tue Jun 22, 10:00-11:30
- Wed Jun 23, 13:00-14:30
- Thu Jun 24, 09:00-10:30

Attendees from our side I expect to join: Marissa (AE) to cover commercial/rollout questions, Dylan (Solutions Eng) to lead the technical demo, and Marcus (Infra Eng) for deployment and network discussion. I attached a short agenda and a suggested prep list.

Please let me know which slot works best or send a couple windows that work for your engineers. If none of these fit, happy to expand availability.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: tech-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (agenda, 1 page)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive (ML / Infra)

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the recap and suggested agenda — looks good. I checked with the ML and infra leads.

We can do Wed Jun 23 13:00-14:30 PT (90 minutes) — that works best for everyone.

Attendees from Acme: myself, Priya Natarajan (ML lead), Rishi Malhotra (infra), and our security lead (TBD).

Two quick asks before the call:
1) Can you share any example questions or telemetry we should pull beforehand?
2) Can you confirm whether you plan to demo on a hosted endpoint or a private deployment in the session?

If you can send a calendar invite, I’ll confirm with security and lock it in.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of ML Engineering | Acme Health Tech
alex.johnson@acmehealth.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive (ML / Infra)

Folks — forwarding Alex's confirmation. Wed 6/23 13:00-14:30 PT for a 90-min deep dive.

High-level asks from Alex:
- Priya (ML) and Rishi (infra) will attend + security lead may join
- They asked for a short list of telemetry/questions to pull before the call
- They want to know whether we'll demo hosted vs private deployment

Dylan: can you own the demo and prepare a short slide + notebook flow for: model selection, quantization tradeoffs, and a quick live inference on a sample payload? Aim for ~30-35 mins of the session for the demo.

Marcus: please prepare a 15-20 min section on network requirements (VPC, egress, KMS), and a simple deployment diagram we can share.

Marissa: please have the proposed rollout options and commercial bullets ready — they already signaled interest in dedicated capacity.

I attached the agenda — think we should also send Alex a 5-point prep checklist they can use to pull telemetry (peak QPS windows, distribution of sequence lengths, tokenization example, sample payloads, and current caching behavior).

Thanks team — I’ll send the calendar invite once you confirm you’re available to present.

Best,
Camila

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
